scientific_hypothesis: Per-anchor feature-axis standardization before ReLU and BatchTopK will prevent global logit shift and provide normalization-mediated gradients to unselected logits while preserving within-anchor feature ranking and natural support.

isolated_intervention.location: after shared feature readout and before ReLU

matched_factors: parameter initialization seed and tensor values
Gemma and SmolLM2 pinned revisions and layers
internal binary support and rank-one objective

if_global_shift_starvation_is_material: treatment gate logits retain a large positive-candidate population through step 1221
treatment late natural-support effective size materially exceeds control
treatment late top-feature event share is materially below control
if_rank_competition_is_sufficient: projection logits may drift while standardized gate candidate counts remain healthy
natural-support effective size still collapses by steps 768-1221

failure_outcomes: candidate counts improve but natural-support diversity fails a threshold
diversity improvement is transient and collapses by step 1221
activation or internal reconstruction exceeds a regression threshold
source immutability, matched batches, or resume validation fails
interpretation_boundary: A single matched seed that passes is exploratory evidence for longer confirmation, not authorization for 500M training or proof of semantic interpretability.
